name: thesis-bus-legacy-dual-v1
resac_action: Both actor coordinates use the existing 0..60 policy units. Coordinate 0 is holding seconds; coordinate 1 maps affinely to speed ratio 0.8..1.2. Replay and critic retain both original policy coordinates.
cs_action: Both actor coordinates remain in -1..1. Holding is 30*(a0+1); speed ratio is 1+0.2*a1. Replay retains the complete normalized action, not physical commands.
reward: Headway retains each frozen environment's native rigid/ridge reward. Passenger is -(2*global_wait_increment+global_in_vehicle_increment) over the unchanged same-vehicle observation interval. Operating metrics use one independent system integral, not a sum of overlapping rewards.
symbolic_extension: Reuse the frozen one-control SINDy holding reference and repaired normalized Jacobian penalties only on the holding output. No speed-effect reference is inferred from data that contained no speed interventions. The second policy output and its critic coupling are learned through SAC.
comparison: Reuse all existing uninterrupted 100-episode holding endpoints and their exact evaluation seeds. The NAU/MLP and symbolic cohorts have distinct evaluation days and are reported separately. New dual policies use all prespecified seeds and final endpoints; no test-based selection. Include zero-holding fixed-speed 1.2 controls separately from learned policies.
preservation: Only this new experiment directory is edited. Existing Thesis branches and active RE-SAC, CS-BAPR, CFCMT and sumo-rl projects are unchanged. Server-resident policies, runtime snapshots and identification data are reused without downloading them. Only compact analysis is retrieved.
